audit_log_row_unless_refused.name: audit_log_row_unless_refused
audit_log_row_unless_refused.value: (action = 'back_entry_refused' AND row_id IS NULL) OR (action <> 'back_entry_refused' AND row_id IS NOT NULL)

audit_personal_values_redacted_blank.name: audit_personal_values_redacted_blank
audit_personal_values_redacted_blank.value: redacted = 0 OR (before IS NULL AND after IS NULL)

check_ins_member_or_pass.name: check_ins_member_or_pass
check_ins_member_or_pass.value: (member_id IS NOT NULL AND day_pass_id IS NULL) OR (member_id IS NULL AND day_pass_id IS NOT NULL)

check_ins_door_or_desk.name: check_ins_door_or_desk
check_ins_door_or_desk.value: (source = 'door' AND kind = 'scan_using' AND door_event_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_by_account_id IS NULL AND entered_by_name IS NULL) OR (source = 'desk' AND door_event_id IS NULL AND entered_by_account_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_by_name IS NOT NULL)

check_ins_pass_desk_is_readmission.name: check_ins_pass_desk_is_readmission
check_ins_pass_desk_is_readmission.value: day_pass_id IS NULL OR source = 'door' OR kind = 'override'

rejections_reason_matches_scan.name: rejections_reason_matches_scan
rejections_reason_matches_scan.value: (reason = 'invalid_code' AND member_id IS NULL AND day_pass_id IS NULL) OR (reason IN ('expired', 'already_used_today') AND member_id IS NOT NULL AND day_pass_id IS NULL) OR (reason = 'pass_not_valid' AND member_id IS NULL AND day_pass_id IS NOT NULL)

members_code_until_erased.name: members_code_until_erased
members_code_until_erased.value: (erased = 0 AND code IS NOT NULL) OR (erased = 1 AND code IS NULL)

payments_reference_for_e_wallet.name: payments_reference_for_e_wallet
payments_reference_for_e_wallet.value: (method = 'cash' AND reference_number IS NULL) OR (method IN ('gcash', 'maya') AND reference_number IS NOT NULL AND replace(reference_number, ' ', '') <> '')

products_sealed_or_menu.name: products_sealed_or_menu
products_sealed_or_menu.value: (kind = 'sealed' AND stock_count IS NOT NULL AND low_stock_level IS NOT NULL AND takes_add_ons = 0 AND needs_member = 0) OR (kind = 'menu' AND stock_count IS NULL AND low_stock_level IS NULL)

stock_movements_kind_shape.name: stock_movements_kind_shape
stock_movements_kind_shape.value: (kind = 'restock' AND quantity_change > 0 AND sale_line_id IS NULL AND voids_movement_id IS NULL AND correction_reason IS NULL) OR (kind = 'sale' AND quantity_change < 0 AND sale_line_id IS NOT NULL AND voids_movement_id IS NULL AND correction_reason IS NULL AND amount_paid_centavos IS NULL) OR (kind = 'void' AND sale_line_id IS NULL AND voids_movement_id IS NOT NULL AND correction_reason IS NULL AND amount_paid_centavos IS NULL) OR (kind = 'correction' AND sale_line_id IS NULL AND voids_movement_id IS NULL AND correction_reason IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_centavos IS NULL)
